corrections.issue: Jim says the wealth effect matters more than almost anything except the Fed and then that it is about 50/50 with the Fed, not clearly second to it.
corrections.fix: The wealth effect from equities and equity-linked collateral (about $200 trillion; a 10% fall removes about $20 trillion) is, Jim says, roughly as important as the Fed itself ('50/50') for the macro outcome and more important than anything else.

completeness_estimate: 0.87 - the first reader caught the main volatility-pinning, carry, Trump-policy, wealth-effect and Fed-reflexivity ideas; missed the late-July trend resumption, the short-term-traders index data, the leverage-needs-convexity rule, the dollar/inflation export valve, the 95%-loans collateral link, the Druckenmiller cascade and the re-pin and Nvidia-put hedge points.
